failure_reason: Genuine New Arrivals PLPs were found and confirmed for the Home & Kitchen department (whole-department listing + 5 real sub-department children), but noon.com's own UI never displays an exact product count for any of them -- only a rounded/bucketed figure (e.g. '1K+', '9K+'). Per the qty rule this is recorded as qty:null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag, so a large fraction of rows are null even though the category structure itself is reliably confirmed.
notes:
SCOPE: Home & Kitchen department per task instruction. ACCESS: curl_cffi (Chrome TLS impersonation) reached the site reliably (HTTP 200 on every request); plain curl/PowerShell/urllib and Playwright's bundled Chromium could not complete the connection to noon.com from this environment. robots.txt explicitly allows ClaudeBot.

DISCOVERY: checked the Home & Kitchen mega-menu and the /home-kitchen/, /home-decor/, /furniture/, /kitchen-dining/, /tools-and-home-improvement-store/, /bath-and-bedding/ landing pages. Every one of the 6 pages carries its own distinctly-titled 'New arrivals' carousel (H1 on the destination page names the specific scope, e.g. 'New arrivals Furniture', 'New arrival Kitchen and dining', 'New arrivals Home improvement', 'New arrivals Bath bedding', 'New arrivals home decor'), each a genuinely different listing (different URL, different bucketed count) -- recorded as a grouping row (whole Home & Kitchen department) + 5 leaf children (Home Decor, Furniture, Kitchen & Dining, Tools & Home Improvement, Bath & Bedding), the same real site structure pattern as Bestsellers, even though this particular module isn't presented as a UI tab set the way Bestsellers is -- each child is its own standalone page surfaced from its own department landing page.

Note the department children's bucketed counts (4K+1K+6K+3K+2K = 16K+ combined) exceed the whole-department parent's own bucketed figure (9K+); this is an artifact of all figures being rounded-down lower bounds on a marketplace with heavy cross-listing, not a data error -- each row's qty/evidence stands on its own page, none is derived from summing others.

No separate marketplace-wide (non-Home-and-Kitchen) New Arrivals page was included (out of department scope). No local-language (Arabic) equivalent search performed beyond the uae-en English locale pages, which is what the site serves by default under /uae-en/.
